headline: The bright patch has left the desk.
body: It sits now on the far floorboard, thinner than at noon. Someone in the next room is eating an apple; the skin is the loud part. Outside, a single car takes the corner without braking.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high cloud, still dry, light gone white

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one car, no horn, wrapper on the step
